text:
marie: uploaded new draft of the launch post + compact benchmarks: https://docs.google.com/launch-draft-4135. Need copy lock by Thu EOD so design can lock hero and ops can finish webinar routing. Quick pass pls :pray:

cleo: reading now. small tone edits and one line flagged for compliance (phrase: 'bank-level isolation').

omar: I can pull p50/p95 and sample sizes and drop a CSV into the doc by noon. Will include sampling notes.

isabel: CTA routing proposal pasted in the doc: 
``
Top CTA: Start free -> no gate
Mid CTA: Request demo -> HubSpot form 90321 -> list: Demo_Inbound_Q2
Footer CTA: Register webinar -> HubSpot form 90399 -> list: Webinar_Registrants_Q2
Add property: campaign=launch_q2_2026, source=launch_blog
``

mike: For demo leads, route to SDR_Inbound and set property priority=high if company_size > 100. I'll build workflows once forms are confirmed.

legal-bot: Auto-scan: phrase flagged: 'bank-level isolation'. Please replace or attach compliance link (SOC2).

marie: change to 'enterprise-grade controls' and add SOC2 link. I'll update now.

cleo: small ask: call out p95 in the subhead (design wants 'Predictable, cost-efficient inference (p95)'). Keeps claims honest.

omar: uploaded latency CSV: https://drive.google.com/latency_q2.csv — includes p50/p95 and sample sizes; sampling excludes requests <64 tokens.

marie: timeline check: if copy locks Thu EOD, can we publish Fri 10am PT? Design needs hero lock by Thu 6pm.

mike: yep publishing + workflows doable with that timeline.

isabel: I pasted webinar invite copy in the doc (section: Webinar Invite v1). Subject + 3 bullets. CTA text: 'See it in action'.

legal-bot: Re-scan scheduled. Will clear once https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2 is present in the doc.

marie: headline votes? A: 'Serve LLMs at scale, predictably' B: 'Run inference that costs less, performs better' — react with :one: or :two:. design prefers shorter.

cleo: :one:

omar: :two:

marie: ok will pick A but apply micro tweak to subhead per Cleo. Action owners: marie -> add SOC2 link (done), omar -> data upload (done), mike -> workflows + publish scheduling, isabel -> finalise webinar invite. Please react :white_check_mark: when your item is complete so I can close the loop. Thanks!
